name: pdf_create
description:
Generate NEW PDF documents from text, images, or stash files. This is for PDF OUTPUT generation, not reading existing PDFs, not software development.

Use this when:
- User wants a PDF report, document, or printable output
- User says 'create PDF', 'make a report', 'generate document'
- Combining images and text into a single document
- Formatting data for printing

Do NOT use for:
- Reading/extracting from existing PDFs → use pdf_read instead
- Merging/splitting existing PDFs → use pdf_read instead
- Searching text in PDFs → use pdf_read instead
- Building software/apps → use opencode instead
- Just downloading images → use stash instead
- Interactive content → use canvas instead

Workflow direction:
- pdf_create: text/images → PDF (generate TO pdf)
- pdf_read: PDF → text/images/info (extract FROM pdf)

Examples:
- 'Create a PDF report about X' → action: create, text: '...', title: 'X Report'
- 'Make a PDF with the logo and schedule' → action: create, files: ['logo.png'], text: '...'
- 'Generate a printable document' → action: from_text, text: '...'

The PDF is saved to stash and can be printed.

space_id.description: Stash space ID containing source files and for output

files.description: List of stash file_ids or stash:// refs to include in PDF

text.description: Text content to include (supports basic markdown headers)
